verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a multi-session mode that starts multiple agents in parallel on the same project (opencode-docs-17). `--auto` auto-approval, a headless `opencode serve` server with an SDK, and GitHub Actions task execution provide building blocks for unattended, orchestrated runs; community users confirm subagents and a WebUI that connects to multiple backends. Nothing documents multi-day autonomous runs or fleet-scale orchestration, and one user reports agents getting stuck in long or nested sessions (opencode-comm-8), which undercuts the hours-or-days part of the story. Missing for 10: first-party fleet orchestration across separate tasks or repos, evidence of reliable multi-hour or multi-day autonomous runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of parallel fleets at scale.
